Callout.Name: Overdose in a Park
Callout.Message: Person unresponsive on a bench, paraphernalia nearby.
Callout.Advisory: Breathing but not waking, no witnesses.

Script.Line: It was meant to be the same as always. It was not the same.
Nobody gave it to me. I am not saying who did.
There is no name on it, is there. There is never a name on it.

Callout.Patient: Where - what day is it? Did somebody call you?

Lines.Approach: Breathing but not waking, and nobody with him. You are the first one there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
